This role caught my attention because it is the kind of support work I have been doing and want to keep doing. You ask for someone who can help people through technical problems calmly, and that is how I like to work. I enjoy the moment a stubborn problem finally gives way, and I like leaving the user with a clear note of what changed.

In my recent roles I answered support requests, fixed problems at the source and wrote down the steps so others could repeat them. The posting mentions working with users who are not technical, and I am used to explaining things in plain words without talking down to anyone. I also keep a tidy record of what I have done, which makes handovers easier for the whole team.

I work well remotely. I keep written updates clear, I reply on time and I ask for help early when I am stuck. I can arrange my hours to overlap with your team and I am comfortable working with people in different time zones.

Thank you for reading this. I would be glad to talk about how I can help, and I can share more detail on any part of my experience.
